cards.text: The text tells us right up front: the LORD is about to take Elijah the prophet up to heaven in a whirlwind. Elijah is on his way from Gilgal with Elisha son of Shaphat, the man God chose to succeed him as prophet (1 Kings 19:16). Friend, most stories don't hand you the big moment in the first line, so buckle up.
Then Elijah turns to Elisha: "Please stay here, for the LORD has sent me on to Bethel."

cards.question: Elijah asks Elisha to stay put while he goes on to Bethel. What does Elisha say?

answers.text: He will wait there for Elijah
He will catch up in a few days

cards.text: Elisha is sticking to Elijah like dough on a rolling pin: shake it, scrape it, it is COMING with you. So they go down to Bethel, and the sons of the prophets there come out to meet Elisha.

cards.question: At Bethel, what do the sons of the prophets ask Elisha?

answers.text: If he knows the LORD will take his master today
If he will stay and lead the prophets there
If Elijah has come to speak to all of them

cards.question: Elisha tells the sons of the prophets at Bethel that this is the first he's heard of it.

cards.text: "Yes, I know," Elisha replies. "Do not speak of it." Then Elijah tries again: "Please stay here, for the LORD has sent me on to Jericho."
Elisha makes the same promise: "As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you." So they go to Jericho.

The sons of the prophets at Jericho ask Elisha the same question, and he gives them the same answer. It's like my oven timer beeping every five minutes to tell me the cookies are almost done: I KNOW. I KNOW.

cards.question: At Jericho, Elijah asks Elisha to stay a third time. Where does Elijah say the LORD is sending him now?
This third time, Elisha finally agrees to stay behind.

cards.text: So the two of them go on. Fifty of the sons of the prophets go and stand at a distance, facing Elijah and Elisha as the two of them stand by the Jordan.

cards.question: Elijah and Elisha are at the edge of the Jordan. Elijah takes his cloak and rolls it up. What does he do with it?
The waters part to the right and to the left, and they cross over on ___ ground.
The fifty sons of the prophets cross the Jordan with Elijah and Elisha.

cards.text: On the far side of the Jordan, Elijah turns to Elisha: "Tell me, what can I do for you before I am taken away from you?"

cards.question: Elijah asks what he can do for Elisha before he's taken away. What does Elisha ask for?

answers.text: A double portion of Elijah's spirit
A long life in the land of Israel
A blessing on all the prophets

cards.question: Elijah tells Elisha that what he asked for is an easy thing.

cards.text: "You have requested a difficult thing," Elijah says, but it can still be Elisha's, on one condition. When somebody offers me a favor, I ask for help scrubbing the cookie trays, and Elisha just asked for a DOUBLE portion of a prophet's spirit.

cards.question: What is Elijah's condition for Elisha to receive the double portion?

answers.text: He must see Elijah taken from him
He must stay beside the Jordan
He must wait there for three days

cards.text: So they walk along, talking together, and then suddenly a chariot of fire with horses of fire appears. Friend, I'd have dropped every cookie tray in the bakery.

cards.question: The chariot of fire with horses of fire ___ the two of them.
Elisha watches as Elijah goes up into heaven in a whirlwind.

cards.text: As Elisha watches, he cries out, "My father, my father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!" And then he sees Elijah no more.

cards.question: Elisha sees Elijah no more. What does he do with his own clothes?

cards.text: Then Elisha picks up the cloak that had fallen from Elijah, and he goes back and stands on the bank of the Jordan. Same river, same cloak, but this time it's just him.

cards.question: Elisha is on the bank of the Jordan, holding Elijah's cloak. What does he do with it?

cards.text: As he strikes the waters with Elijah's cloak, Elisha asks, "Where now is the LORD, the God of Elijah?" Friend, I've held my breath at the oven window for a whole lot less than a river.

cards.question: When Elisha strikes the waters, they part and he crosses over.

cards.text: The sons of the prophets have been watching Elisha from Jericho, and they saw what happened at the river. I bet nobody over there blinked for a solid minute.

cards.question: The sons of the prophets just saw Elisha part the Jordan. What do they say?

answers.text: The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha
Elijah will surely come back to them
Elisha should not have taken the cloak

cards.question: The sons of the prophets go to meet Elisha and bow down to the ground before him.

cards.text: Then they offer to send fifty valiant men to search for Elisha's master, in case the Spirit of the LORD put him on one of the mountains or in one of the valleys. FIFTY men, friend, and it takes me ten minutes to find one oven mitt.

cards.question: The sons of the prophets want to send fifty men to search for Elijah. What does Elisha tell them?

cards.text: But they press him to the point of embarrassment, and finally he says, "Send them." It's like the coworker who asks if you're SURE you don't want the last cookie, then asks again, then AGAIN, until you just take the cookie.

cards.question: The fifty men go out looking for Elijah. How long do they search?
The fifty men find Elijah in one of the valleys.

cards.text: They come back to Elisha, who's staying in Jericho, and he says, "Didn't I tell you not to go?" I say that same line to myself every time I grab a hot cookie tray without my mitt.
Then the men of the city tell Elisha that their city's location is good, but the water is bad and the land is unfruitful. It's like a bakery with a GREAT view and an oven that won't turn on.

cards.question: Elisha asks them to bring him a new bowl with some ___ in it.
Elisha casts the salt into the spring and speaks. Who does he say has healed the water?
After Elisha's word, the water in that city soon goes bad again.

cards.text: From there, Elisha goes up to Bethel. As he walks up the road, a group of boys comes out of the city and jeers at him, chanting, "Go up, you baldhead! Go up, you baldhead!"

cards.question: Elisha turns around and looks at the boys jeering at him. What does he do?

answers.text: Calls down a curse in the LORD's name
Keeps walking without saying a word
Asks the LORD to forgive all of them

cards.text: Suddenly two female bears come out of the woods and maul forty-two of the boys.
Then Elisha goes on to Mount Carmel, and from there he returns to Samaria. Elijah has been taken up, and now Elisha is the one walking the road.
